materials.en: Water, galvanised steel trays, submersible pumps, fluorescent tube, timber, mains power
materials.da: Vand, galvaniserede stålbakker, dykpumper, lysstofrør, tømmer, netstrøm

note.en: Footprint adapts to the room; the water surface is always a single continuous plane.
note.da: Grundfladen tilpasses rummet; vandoverfladen er altid ét sammenhængende plan.

existenceNote.en: The trays and pumps are in storage. The work exists as long as someone is willing to keep the water level.
existenceNote.da: Bakkerne og pumperne står på lager. Værket findes, så længe nogen vil holde vandstanden.

statementOfSignificance.en: Standing Water holds a shallow plane of water absolutely still in a room that is not still. Four submersible pumps run continuously to cancel the movement the building itself introduces — footfall, ventilation, the tram outside. The work is therefore not an object but a maintained condition, and it fails the moment the maintenance stops. Each realisation is measured against the room it is in: the plane grows or shrinks so that it always reads as one surface rather than several trays. What a visitor sees is a floor that has become level in a building that is not.
statementOfSignificance.da: Standing Water holder et lavt vandplan fuldstændig stille i et rum, der ikke er stille. Fire dykpumper kører uafbrudt for at ophæve den bevægelse, bygningen selv tilfører — fodtrin, ventilation, sporvognen udenfor. Værket er derfor ikke en genstand, men en vedligeholdt tilstand, og det ophører i samme øjeblik vedligeholdelsen gør. Hver opførelse måles mod det rum, den står i: planet vokser eller skrumper, så det altid læses som én flade og ikke som flere bakker. Det, en besøgende ser, er et gulv, der er blevet vandret i en bygning, der ikke er det.

variability.en: The number of trays, the footprint and the pump count all follow the room. Fixed: the water depth (38 mm), the single fluorescent tube, and the rule that the plane must never be broken by a walkway.
variability.da: Antallet af bakker, grundfladen og antallet af pumper følger rummet. Fast: vanddybden (38 mm), det ene lysstofrør og reglen om, at planet aldrig må brydes af en gangbro.

components.en: Levelling timber sub-frame, built on site
components.da: Afretningsramme i træ, bygget på stedet

equipmentRequiredFromVenue.en: Level floor within 4 mm across the footprint
equipmentRequiredFromVenue.da: Plant gulv inden for 4 mm over hele grundfladen

equipmentRequiredFromVenue.en: Water access and a drain within 25 m
equipmentRequiredFromVenue.da: Vandadgang og afløb inden for 25 m

notes.en: Levelling is the whole install. Budget a full day for the sub-frame alone.
notes.da: Afretningen er hele opsætningen. Sæt en hel dag af til rammen alene.
